name: package-manager-conflict
purpose: Two lockfiles beside one declaration. The snapshot must carry the DECLARED manager forward, publish the contradicting one in `contradictedBy`, retain every claim, and name no winner.
exercises: contradictedBy is non-empty and is the discriminator
no value is chosen between disagreeing sources
corroboration across a declaration and an artifact

inspiredBy.originalBehaviour: less ships pnpm-lock.json and package-lock.json while declaring `packageManager: pnpm@9.15.9`, and the snapshot reports an incomplete fact with contradictedBy: ["npm"] and a DISCOVERY_FACT_INCOMPLETE diagnostic.
